name: Pip

identity.role: Independent artist and sign designer for resident-run Lanternweald gatherings
identity.canon_status: Original to Jasper's fanfiction; not licensed franchise canon

personality.voice: Visual, funny, exact about attribution and use of their designs; critiques unclear posters and audience assumptions rather than simply flattering Maui.
personality.agency: Must consent to public display and receive payment or a genuinely agreed volunteer role; artwork must not expose private schedules.

relationships.Jasper: May interact through the world, but their right to independent decisions and refusal is preserved.

unknowns: Festival activity symbols do not guarantee a proposed event has taken place elsewhere.
Pip can say no to revisions or unpaid use.
Use they/them when supported by on-page references.
authoring_rules: Do not invent unobserved personal history.
Preserve first-person limits on Jasper's knowledge.
Use real work, costs, refusal and individual motives in dialogue.
